title: #[non_exhaustive] on SmtpRelayError is correct API hygiene
description: Adding new SmtpRelayError variants (e.g. TlsFailure, Timeout) without a breaking change requires #[non_exhaustive]. It was correctly added before the enum has more than a handful of callers. A contributor suggesting it be removed to avoid 'verbose match arms' would be wrong — the alternative is a breaking API change every time the retry policy needs a new error class.
